cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A presents unauthorised grape tasting as a proper quality test, correcting B sampling technique while arranging that B breaks the rule before A does.
confusable: Ordinary temptation lacks expert procedural corrections used to put the first risk on B.
comparison: Bride alternative exploits doorway and train handling; grape scene uses visible sample preparation and tasting sequence.
seedUse: Grape seed supplies no-tasting rule and B insisting A hold bunch visibly; S03 should correct the method instead of merely saying just one.
